Samaritan Health Services is a non-profit healthcare system based in Corvallis, Oregon, operating five hospitals and over 110 physician clinics throughout the mid-Willamette Valley and central Oregon Coast.
Established in 1997, they employ nearly 7,000 staff and offer a comprehensive range of services, including emergency care, surgery, and specialty clinics.
Loads of Team Time Spent on Manual Recurring Work

Reporting to the 340B ESP Portal requires incredible manual work due to the specific reporting requirements of the platform and the complexity of drug qualification created by the manufacturers. Healthcare systems also have to account for strict eligibility rules to ensure they report out accurately, otherwise risking program eligibility and significant 340B savings.
These bi-weekly reporting cycles would require the Samaritan team to be stuck in piles of spreadsheets doing painstaking and manual work to ensure their program remained compliant.
Since onboarding Plenful in 2024, Samaritan has recognized a huge reduction in time spent on their ESP reporting cycles –
Days spent wrangling hairy spreadsheets and stitching together information across a wide variety of data sources are now behind them.

The Samaritan team not only benefits from time back to focus on higher-value work, but can also rest easy at night. Plenful's reports fueled by the power of machine learning and AI are more accurate than human-led audits, helping protect critical 340B savings. For most Plenful clients, these savings can add up to millions of dollars annually.

Plenful’s report is more accurate than what Samaritan was previously able to produce manually. Accurate reporting ensures maintenance of their 340B drug pricing, securing millions of dollars in critical cost savings and program benefits.
